We noticed during the course of many many years of DBA related work that fixes to database issues and queries are always reactive. - figure out which indexes are actually bad and slowing down writes

show_hn.story_text:
Hi all,
With everybody (and especially companies) using AI agents, I have decided to work on a deterministic guardrail tool for AI agents. What does it mean? 
On the same way that an AI agent can run “terraform plan”, it can also run “terraform destroy”. The tool ALLOWS or BLOCKS AI commands accordingly, to avoid unexpected “tragedies”. 
Please, note that this is not a hardened sandbox. The tool can be bypassed by a capable person or process, since this is my first proof of concept. I would like to present it to the community and receive honest feedback (pros, cons, issues, concerns, is it really useful? Would companies be interested in using it?).
